$comment: Cast: photos from the character cards (Journal/Cards/<Name>.pdf, front) used as dialogue portraits, and the card backs as notebook bios.
Photos of real people from the original project, used with the project owner's consent. focus = CSS object-position of the face in the square crop.
Web copies are built by tools/build-journal-assets.py into web/assets/journal/.

petronio.name: Petronio
petronio.bio: Should I describe myself? I warn you, it will be boring! I know nothing but rigour and discipline because I grew up in the strict school environment regulated by the reform. But now I want more, I need to see the outside world and find my true identity.

sirio.name: Sirio
sirio.bio: What should I say? I’m Sirio, I’m 19. I’m rather confused, most of the time. I love surfing, skateboarding, build my stuff, streams of consciousness, taking photos, feel free. I forget things, already said?

yda.name: Yda
yda.bio: Minimalist, diffident, intuitive. Just an ordinary girl frustrated by the inconsistency of others. Don’t mess with the natural order of the world, or you’ll face me. Like putting salt into sweet vanilla.

minerva.name: Minerva
minerva.bio: Order, discipline and rigour are the main pillars of society. Control is what I like most: the rigorousness of classical compositions, minimalist art and my beloved parrots that get out of their cages only when I decide it.

roberto.name: Roberto
roberto.bio: I have an ambitious double-life goal: never be caught jumping the fence. I live as two, I travel as two, I drink as two and I sleep as half a person. If the rules were written in Helvetica I think I could almost respect them. A a E e R r A a E e R r

guido.name: Guido
guido.bio: Art, beauty, aesthetics are lifestyle for me. I hate boundaries, I like free form thinking people. Equality and sharing of moments and beauty will make society better and better. Oh, and don’t forget to train.

gabriele.name: Gabriele
gabriele.bio: I haven't much to say. I hate talking about me. I produce crafted beer and liquor. I believe in self-expression and I love what allows me to express myself. These are all there is to know.

su.name: Su
su.bio: I live a peaceful life. I appreciate the culture: it helped me to develop my interest and free thinking. I have a bijoux shop: I make stuff to express myself. I admire freedom, creativity and self-expression.
